## Summary

Provide a brief but clear overview of the change and the problem it addresses.

- What changed?
- Why is this needed?
- Does this affect the theme, documentation, examples, generated assets, or build workflow?

## Issue reference

Please reference the relevant issue or discussion in the PR description.

- Use a closing reference such as: `Fixes #<issue-number>`
- If the work was prompted by a GitHub issue comment or discussion, briefly summarize the request here.
- If the change modifies a public theme option, configuration variable, CSS behavior, or JavaScript behavior, include the related issue and note any required documentation updates.

## Changes made

- [ ] Briefly describe the main implementation change.
- [ ] List the files, components, or sections updated.
- [ ] Document any new configuration options, CSS variables, JavaScript behavior, or example updates.
- [ ] Note any visual or UX changes affecting the rendered theme.

## Validation

- [ ] I have tested the change locally.
- [ ] I have verified the affected documentation pages or examples render correctly.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where relevant.
- [ ] I have checked the rendered output for the affected component or page.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have linked the related issue or discussion to this PR.
- [ ] I have described the change and the purpose clearly.
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation, examples, or release notes when needed.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for the changed behavior.
- [ ] I have followed the repository coding style and conventions.
- [ ] I have reviewed my changes before submitting this PR.
- [ ] If I introduced a new theme option or configuration setting, I have documented it and updated the relevant examples and/or theme documentation table where appropriate.
- [ ] The PR title follows conventional commit style (for example: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `test:`).

## Notes for maintainers

Include any additional context for reviewers here, such as:

- screenshots or visual comparisons
- known limitations
- follow-up work
- compatibility considerations
- any special review guidance
